result.target_topic: Visa share exchange and resulting gains
result.target_summary: In 2024, the Firm exchanged 37.2 million Visa B-1 shares for Visa B-2 and C shares, resulting in an initial $8.0 billion gain and a total second-quarter net gain of $7.9 billion, before disposing of all Visa C shares by September 30, 2024.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation: Both rows cover the Visa B share exchange program. D117 establishes the holding of Visa B shares (approx 37M) subject to restrictions and litigation uncertainty. D119 details the Jan 2024 stockholder approval for the exchange program. D096 reports the execution of this exchange in 2024 (37.2M shares exchanged for B-2 and C shares), resulting in gains. The evidence shows the progression from holding/restrictions (D117) to the approved mechanism (D119) to the executed transaction (D096).

comparisons.peer_topic: Gain on Personal Installment Loan Sale
comparisons.peer_summary: Citi recorded a $5 million incremental gain in Q2 2023 from post-closing contingency payments for a previously disclosed sale of ruble-denominated personal installment loans, which had resulted in an overall pretax net loss of approximately $7 million.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Citi disclose significant financial gains recognized in the second quarter of their reporting period. JPMorgan reports a $7.9 billion net gain in Q2 2024 resulting from the exchange and disposal of Visa shares. In contrast, Citi reports a much smaller $5 million incremental gain in Q2 2023 (referenced in the 2024 filing context regarding post-closing adjustments for a loan sale) related to contingency payments on a personal installment loan sale.

sentences.text: In addition, the second quarter of 2024 also reflected other Visa-related activity, including the fair value changes of the Visa C shares and derivative instruments, as well as dividends, resulting in the $7.9 billion net gain on Visa shares in the quarter.

• During the second quarter of 2023, Citi recorded an incremental gain of $5 million related to post-closing contingency payments for a previously disclosed personal installment loan sale in Other revenue. The previously disclosed sale of a portfolio of ruble-denominated personal installment loans resulted in a pretax net loss on sale of approximately $7 million.
